title: With Reports ON, all 6 AP/AR aging reports are listed (whether or not AP/AR is on)
custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with the Reports page access ON and View and Manage AP/AR Data ON.
  2. There is some invoice/payment data so the reports have rows.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top navigation.
  2. Look at the list of reports.
  3. Find the 6 aging reports: AR Aging Summary, AR Aging Detail, AR Aging Collection, AP Aging Summary, AP Aging Detail, AP Unpaid Invoices.
  4. Open each of the 6 reports one at a time.
custom_expected:
The Reports page opens.

All 6 aging reports are listed because Reports access is on (aging reports follow the Reports page access, not AP/AR).

Each report opens and shows its data with no permission error.

Whether View and Manage AP/AR Data is on or off does not change which aging reports are listed.
evidence: UI (admin /reports, Reports ON): all 6 AP/AR aging reports are listed — A/R Aging Summary, A/R Aging Detail, A/R Aging Collection, A/P Aging Summary, A/P Aging Detail, A/P Unpaid Invoices. screenshot reports-admin.
